claim: California order directs recommendations, including possible statutory amendments.

candidateEvidence.excerpt: It did not install a universal AI kill switch.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: The Government Operations Agency, in consultation with the Governor’s Office of Emergency Services, shall, no later than November 16, 2026, submit to my office recommendations, developed in consultation with national experts, addressing the technical feasibility and potential efficacy of amendments to existing state laws regarding AI safety and security, including at least the following:

EFF supports the focus on expanding reporting requirements under SB 53 for loss-of-control incidents, alongside third-party investigations. ... the effectiveness of kill switches in advanced AI systems remains an area of active research. ... government-controlled kill switches run the risk of being used as a form of retaliation against protected speech.

scopeAndFreshness: Signed order and current EFF statement refreshed September 26; recommendation directive, not an installed universal switch.

claim: California enacted selected data-centre reporting and assessment duties.

candidateEvidence.excerpt: An assessment is not an adopted tariff or a calculated household saving.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: As part of a new or existing proceeding, the commission shall assess opportunities for rate structures to do all of the following:

“Data center” does not include a facility with an electrical capacity of less than 10 megawatts. Beginning with the 2029 integrated energy policy report required pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 25302, and in subsequent biennial reports required pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 25302 thereafter as determined by the commission, the commission shall include an assessment of electrical load trends for data centers.
Governor Newsom today signed seven bills to strengthen California’s approach to data centers — requiring data centers to report about water and electricity use.

This section does not apply to a publicly funded research facility, public safety facility, publicly funded national security facility, publicly owned facility, or other utility facility, including, but not limited to, a facility operated for the purpose of providing telecommunications services to the public by a terrestrial facilities-based telecommunications, cable, or internet service provider.
The commission shall annually publish the information submitted pursuant to subdivision (b) in an anonymized and aggregated format on its internet website.

scopeAndFreshness: SB1168 and AB1577 primary bill texts and the Governor’s count refreshed September 26. SB1168 directs an assessment, not a tariff; AB1577 contains the 10MW threshold, 2029 reporting assessment and stated exclusions. Article covers neither all seven bills nor a calculated household saving.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: Cowork and chat are now one Claude.

This is rolling out to Pro and Max plans first, in the Claude app on web, desktop, and mobile over the coming weeks to existing and new users on these plans. There’s nothing to turn on. Team and Free plans will follow soon, and Enterprise admins will hear from us at least 30 days before anything changes for their organizations.

Claude Docs and Claude Slides are new today, and Claude Design now works inside your conversations too. Ask for a document, and you and Claude write it together. claim: OpenAI announced Sol and Luna for Work and Codex.

candidateEvidence.excerpt: The models were not yet available in Chat, and the company said rollout through the day could delay visibility.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex starting today for all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free and Go users can access GPT‑6 Luna in the desktop app. These models are not yet available in Chat.
To keep service stable for everyone, we plan to roll out these models in ChatGPT gradually throughout the day. If you don’t see the new models in ChatGPT Work or Codex, please try again later.

Evaluations of GPT were performed in our research environment or via our API, which may provide slightly different output from production ChatGPT due to differences in the system prompts, tools available, etc.

scopeAndFreshness: Official release source inspected September 26. Article retains exact availability, rollout and provider-evaluation limits; it does not claim any individual account result or independent performance proof.
